name: icon
label: Gift Icon
help_text: 97×97 gift icon shown to the left of the heading. Upload an SVG/PNG OR paste raw SVG code.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. SVG preferred. Recommended: 97×97px.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste the raw <svg>...</svg> code here. Leave empty if using the upload field above.

name: copy_button_text
label: Copy Button Text
help_text: Label on the copy-to-clipboard button (the top button on the right).

name: copy_button_icon
label: Copy Button Icon
help_text: Small icon shown inside the Copy Link button. Upload SVG/PNG OR paste SVG code.

children.name: image
children.label: Upload Icon (SVG or PNG)
children.help_text: Upload from Files Manager. Recommended: 16×16px SVG.

children.name: svg_code
children.label: Or: Paste SVG Code
children.help_text: Paste the raw <svg>...</svg> code. Leave empty if using the upload field above.

name: copy_success_text
label: Copy Success Text
help_text: Text shown briefly on the button after the link is copied

name: referral_page_url
label: Referral Page Base URL
help_text: Select the referral landing page. Do NOT include a trailing slash — a slash is inserted automatically before the member's unique ID. e.g. base: /referral-page → final: /referral-page/x0f0b6

name: cta_heading
label: Banner Heading
help_text: Main heading shown to the right of the gift icon.

name: cta_subtitle
label: Banner Subtitle
help_text: Smaller body text shown below the heading.
default: Help friends discover VIPSCLUB. Earn rewards together when they join and engage with services.

name: cta_button
label: CTA Button
help_text: The 'Refer a Friend' action button on the right side

children.name: show
children.label: Show Button
children.help_text: Toggle to show or hide the CTA button

children.name: text
children.label: Button Text
children.help_text: Text displayed on the CTA button (the bottom button on the right).

children.name: link_url
children.label: Button Link
children.help_text: Where the button links — typically the Refer a Friend page

children.name: style
children.label: Button Style
children.help_text: Visual style of the CTA button

children.name: background_color
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Leave empty to use theme default (white card)

children.name: padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: hide_on_mobile
children.label: Hide on Mobile
children.help_text: Toggle to hide this module on mobile devices

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Override the default text colour for this module instance. Leave empty for theme default.

children.name: content_width
children.label: Content Width
children.help_text: Control the maximum width of this module's content.
